transcript.text: Raghav Juyal went from looking like this to this.
And you might think it's just because of his fashion, but it's actually his hair and beard game.
Raghav has a long face, narrow chin, and a long neck.
Earlier his hair was shorter on the sides with volume on top and a short beard.
This made his face look even longer and his head felt smaller against his frame.
Now, he does almost the opposite.
His curls grow outward around the temple and ears, which visually adds width to his face.
And instead of growing his beard downwards, he keeps volume around the cheeks and jaw, which makes the lower half of his face look broader.
So if you have a long rectangular face, remember the rule is don't add more length, add width.
Go for a full short beard, a boxed beard, a heavy stubble, or a Garibaldi-style beard.
And for hair, go for grown-out curls, a textured medium-length, or a layered shag.
But avoid tight fades and high pompadours because they'll make your face look even longer.

animations.name: Before/After Slider
animations.what_moves: A vertical divider line sweeps horizontally across the screen, revealing the 'after' portrait over the 'before' portrait.
animations.purpose: To visually demonstrate the dramatic transformation of the subject's appearance.
animations.reusable_as: Comparing any before-and-after states, such as photo editing, cleaning, or styling.

animations.name: Feature Selection Pop-In
animations.what_moves: Two square option cards pop up on the subject's chest, followed by wireframe icons ('HAIR' and 'BEARD') appearing inside them.
animations.layered_with: A wireframe mesh overlay fading onto the subject's hair.
animations.purpose: To introduce the two main categories of the grooming analysis.
animations.reusable_as: Presenting interactive choices or category buttons in a tutorial.

animations.name: Anatomical Wireframe Overlay
animations.what_moves: A digital wireframe grid conforms to the subject's forehead and neck, accompanied by text labels in pill boxes.
animations.purpose: To simulate a high-tech, precise analysis of the subject's facial structure.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting specific product features or anatomical areas in skincare/fitness videos.

animations.name: Dimension Callout Line
animations.what_moves: A vertical dimension line with end ticks draws down alongside the subject's body to indicate height/proportion.
animations.layered_with: A bounding box appearing around the subject's head.
animations.purpose: To illustrate the visual proportion of the head relative to the body frame.
animations.reusable_as: Showing measurements, heights, or scale of objects in product demos.

animations.name: Style Carousel Swipe
animations.what_moves: A series of portrait cards with different beard and hair styles slide horizontally, mimicking a mobile app swipe gesture.
animations.layered_with: Pill badges with checkmarks or crosses popping in below the card.
animations.purpose: To cycle through recommended and non-recommended styles rapidly.
animations.reusable_as: Showcasing a catalog of options, products, or user reviews.
animations.would_need_building: A swipe-based carousel transition with synchronized badge updates.

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements scale up with a springy bounce (PopIn) or slide in from the sides.

animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait of the subject remains anchored to maintain focus on facial changes.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty and informative, with rapid-fire visual callouts synchronized with the voiceover's key points.

what_we_should_steal: The interactive-style swipe carousel for showcasing multiple product variations.
The wireframe contour mapping effect to elevate educational or analytical content.
